name: Skeleton / User Avatar Loading
description: User Avatar Loading product scenario for the Skeleton component.

controls.name: shape
controls.description: What it stands in for: `text` a line of text, painted where a one-line Text puts its glyphs; `rect` a block as wide as its column and one control tall; `circle` an avatar one control across.

controls.name: width
controls.description: Width it paints, in pixels or any CSS length, in place of the shape's default (a text line or rect fills its column, so give one in a container sized by its content); a circle given only a width is as tall.

controls.name: height
controls.description: Height it paints, in pixels or any CSS length, in place of the shape's default; a circle given only a height is as wide.
